requirement.text: System shall validate user credentials before granting access.

test_cases.setup: User database populated with test accounts
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid username 'testuser'
3. Enter valid password 'Test123!'
4. Click Login button
test_cases.expectedResults: User is authenticated and redirected to dashboard

test_case.setup: Sensor connected and calibrated; user logged in with admin privileges
test_case.steps:
1. Set sensor reading to 105 mg/dL
2. Observe UI alert panel
3. Verify alert message content
test_case.expectedResults: Alert displayed within 1 second with message 'Reading exceeds threshold'

upstream_requirements.text: System shall alert when reading exceeds 100 mg/dL.

hazard.hazard_description: Software calculates incorrect insulin dose due to algorithm error
hazard.harm: Severe hypoglycemia, loss of consciousness, potential death
hazard.software_contribution: Primary cause - dose calculation algorithm does not account for active insulin on board

requirements.text: System shall calculate insulin dose based on current blood glucose, target glucose, insulin sensitivity factor, and active insulin on board.
System shall reject dose calculations when active insulin data is unavailable or stale (>15 minutes old).

test_cases.description: Verify dose calculation with active insulin
test_cases.setup: Patient profile loaded; previous dose of 3 units administered 2 hours ago
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter current BG=180 mg/dL
2. Enter target BG=100 mg/dL
3. Enter ISF=50 mg/dL per unit
4. System retrieves active insulin=1.5 units
5. Calculate recommended dose

test_cases.description: Verify rejection when active insulin data stale
test_cases.setup: Patient profile loaded; last insulin data timestamp is 20 minutes old
test_cases.steps:
1. Attempt to calculate dose
2. Observe system response
test_cases.expectedResults: System displays error: 'Active insulin data is stale. Please refresh pump data before calculating dose.'

design_docs.title: Insulin Dose Calculator Algorithm
design_docs.summary: Implements standard correction dose formula: (current_BG - target_BG) / ISF - active_insulin. Includes staleness check on active insulin data (15-minute threshold).
